songs.title: Mi kat wan kaon
songs.lyrics:
Mit kat wan [C]kaon
Mi no save pem
Hemi pemaot [F]kaon
Hem ino mek...em
Mi nidim [C]wan man
Blong I [Am]pemaot sin blong [G]mi 
(ol sin blong [G7]mi)
Nao mi mi sing [C]wan niufala song
Amazing [F]grace
Evri taem mi sing
Kraes Jisas [C]ipemaot
Kaon we [G]mi no [G7]save [C]pem.
